title: dsamoht/mag-ont pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample_id.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

group.errorMessage: Group name must be provided and cannot contain spaces. Samples sharing a group are co-assembled or binned together

assembly_fasta.errorMessage: A pre-existing assembly must be a FASTA file ('.fa', '.fasta' or '.fna', optionally gzipped) and cannot contain spaces

long_reads.errorMessage: Long reads must be gzipped FastQ ('.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz') and cannot contain spaces

short_reads_1.errorMessage: Short reads 1 must be gzipped FastQ ('.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz') and cannot contain spaces

short_reads_2.errorMessage: Short reads 2 must be gzipped FastQ ('.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz') and cannot contain spaces

errorMessage.anyOf: Each row needs either 'long_reads' to assemble or a pre-existing 'assembly_fasta'
errorMessage.dependentRequired: Short reads must be paired: provide both 'short_reads_1' and 'short_reads_2', or neither
